name: freeze-and-is-frozen-test-c0f3b0e88b/addition-to-frozen-json-p.bal
spec_references: Subset restrictions > Import declarations: "Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported"; ballerina/lang.value lists cloneWithType, fromJsonWithType, toString and toBalString, but not cloneReadOnly.
Subset restrictions > Invocations > Other invocation restrictions: "Method call syntax can be used for calling the following langlib functions:"; value:cloneReadOnly is absent.
reason: The asserted panic when adding a field to a frozen JSON map depends on j2.cloneReadOnly(), an unsupported lang.value function and langlib method invocation. Mapping construction and indexed assignment do not make the essential freezing operation supported.
test_design_notes: The @panic annotation asserts that adding newField to the readonly clone fails at runtime.
